name: Corvus Manor
desc:
**The Corvus Manor** sub-location on [Isle of the Crows](location:isle_of_the_crows) with a lot of Authority Enemies in it. The sub-location itself is a big mansion, much alike [Duke Erisia's Manor](location:duke_erisias_manor).

After all of the Authority Enemies are killed an Authority Captain spawns on the outside.
